lines.en: I head into Noriko's room to be immediately greeted by a big hug and a kiss on the cheek.
lines.zh: 我走进 Noriko 的房间，立刻迎来一个大大的拥抱和脸颊上的一吻。

lines.en: As you probably know by now, I'm not the biggest fan of actual affection. But at least she's able to do all of these things without making me feel strange about it.
lines.zh: 你现在大概已经知道了，我并不怎么喜欢真正的亲密接触。但至少她做这些事的时候，不会让我觉得别扭。

lines.en: Despite the notable gap in our ages, there's a clear, unique connection between us that even I have a hard time comprehending.
lines.zh: 尽管年龄差距明显，我们之间却存在着一种清晰而独特的联系，连我自己都难以理解。

lines.en: It's possible that's just this body's old memories banging against the bars of the prison I forced them into, but it could also be that Noriko's just...different.
lines.zh: 也许那只是这具身体里旧日的记忆在撞击我囚禁它们的铁栏，但也可能是 Noriko 本来就……不一样。

lines.en: So I'll continue to spend time with her.
lines.zh: 所以我会继续和她待在一起。

lines.en: Not just to discover why I might be feeling this way, but because the act of discovering in itself is inherently enjoyable.
lines.zh: 不只是为了弄清我为什么会有这种感觉，更因为「去发现」这件事本身就令人愉快。

lines.en: I could have done without the kiss part, but I'm not about to deny a nice, warm hug from one of my favorite people.
lines.zh: 亲吻那部分我倒是可以省了，但我不至于拒绝来自我最喜欢的人之一的一个温暖拥抱。

lines.en: The two of us hang out under the kotatsu, conversing about random things and treating whatever television show she put on as white noise.
lines.zh: 我们两个在被炉下待着，东一句西一句地聊，把她随手打开的电视节目当白噪音。

lines.en: She playfully kicks at my legs from time to time, sort of like how I'd expect a little sister to if I was fortunate enough to have one.
lines.zh: 她时不时顽皮地踢我的腿，有点像我若是有幸有个妹妹时，她会做的那样。

lines.en: I guess Noriko's the closest I'll ever come to that, though.
lines.zh: 不过我想，Noriko 大概是我能离那种感觉最近的人了。

lines.en: So I might as well enjoy this sensation now, while it still lasts.
lines.zh: 所以我还不如趁着这份感觉还在，好好享受它。

lines.en: Because who knows if she'll want to do this when (and if) she ever grows old?
lines.zh: 因为谁知道呢——等她哪天真长大了（如果真有那么一天），她还想不想这么做？
